messages:
Alex: Quick postmortem follow-up from last night's GPU capacity incident — putting owners and timelines here so nothing slips. OpsBot, drop the short summary please.
OpsBot: Incident ID INC-2026-84 — symptom: pods stuck Pending (Insufficient GPUs) after eval job burst. Peak queued pods: 240. Impact window ~01:12–02:36 UTC. Autoscaler autoscale-loop errors: 'timeout waiting for nodes' x72.
Maria: recurring note: the nightly eval cron at 02:00 UTC consistently creates a sharp spike. We've seen this pattern 3x in last 6 weeks. Proposals: (1) throttle eval job concurrency, (2) add soft reservation headroom, (3) schedule quota request earlier in week.
Jin: scheduler tuning suggestion: reduce maxPendingPodsPerNode threshold and increase preemption buffer. Quick patch I want to test in staging:
```
# kube-scheduler config snippet
policies:
  - name: reduce-pending
    args:
      maxPendingPerNode: 4
      preemptionThreshold: 0.75
```
I'll run canary with small load.
Sam: I'll own the cloud quota/commit request. Opening ticket CLOUD-5293 today. ETA for enterprise quota approval is 5 business days. Will post updates in the ticket. @Maria @Alex please add any required justification lines.
Leo: I'll take the scheduler PR and run the staging canary. Target: validate under synthetic spike by Fri EOD. If green, I'll push to canary pool with rollback flag.
Priya: I'll update the capacity model and headroom plan (spreadsheet + runbook section). Action: add a 15% reserved GPU pool for spikes and a cooldown policy for eval jobs. Deliverable: headroom doc + rollout plan by next Wed.
Alex: Concrete action list (summaries):
1) CLOUD-5293 — Sam — quota request submitted today — ETA 5bd
2) Scheduler tuning PR — Leo & Jin — staging tests by Fri, canary next week
3) Headroom & runbook update — Priya — doc due next Wed, include rollback playbook
4) Eval job throttling + cron spread — Maria — propose cron adjustments + rate limiter by Tue
5) Incident follow-up notes + regression checks — Alex — add prompt/eval test set to Redwood Optimize to detect spikes
Please react when you ack or post blockers.
Maria: ack :+1: I will draft the cron change and a brief note for platform teams.
Sam: ticket created: CLOUD-5293 link posted in ticket tracker. Starting quota justification now.
Leo: ack — will post results in #eng-runtime-staging channel.
Jin: I'll schedule a quick sync with Leo & Priya tomorrow to coordinate preemption tests.
Priya: ack — will drop headroom doc link here when done.
Alex: Thanks everyone. If we see the pattern again before these land, fallback is to enable temporary dedicated pool (manual) — I'll keep that standby. OpsBot, remind this thread in 72h for progress check.
OpsBot: Reminder scheduled for +72h.
Alex: Closing thread for now — will reopen if any blocker pops up.
